description.value: Mr. Sushi Lonsdale is a family-owned sushi restaurant that has operated in North Vancouver since 2016, part of a brand with roots going back to the early 1990s. Spanning 2,000 square feet in the Lower Lonsdale waterfront neighbourhood, it offers a modern interior, a broad menu of sushi, sashimi, teriyaki, and noodle dishes, and has earned a North Shore News Readers' Choice Award. Cyclists finishing a ride along the North Shore waterfront will find both dine-in and convenient takeout options a short ride from the SeaBus terminal.
